svg.title: MTL CI/CD architecture
svg.desc: A pull request starts the linter, the build and the gtest and smoke tests. The build waits for the linter, computes the source SHA-256 and uploads the artifacts to the GitHub stash. Each bare metal host computes the same hash, downloads the artifacts, validates the build and runs the tests. The nightly runs do the same on two hosts, wait for both tests, write a report and create a release candidate.

g.text: CI/CD pipeline: PR checks and nightly runs
